# Stoke Club

> Stoke Club is a Southern California indie surf rock band, known for the song Polaroid.

A group of friends who started making music together at the University of Southern California (USC) and started the band in 2025. We write and produce our own records.

## Facts

- Name: Stoke Club (also written Stoke Club Band)
- From: Southern California (Newport Beach, Orange County)
- Formed: 2025
- Genre: Southern California indie surf rock, surf rock, indie rock
- Best known for: Polaroid (released June 1, 2026)
- Also released: Crocodile Tears (released July 3, 2026)
- Songwriters: Eon Kounalakis, Max Amiss, Nicholas Kallins
- Official video: Polaroid (Official Music Video), premiered October 12, 2026: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BKjTfKqHPAI
- Next show: Outheback Concert, Boca Raton, Florida, December 6, 2026 (details at https://stokeclubband.com/shows)
- Next release: Your Friends (November 6, 2026): https://stokeclubband.com/music/your-friends
